actual_visual_review.method: Individually viewed all listed full-page PNGs and all nine selected original PNGs using view_image.

art.caption: An imagined guard with an appetite for the store.
art.alt: An ant stands at the entrance of an open wooden box containing jaggery.
art.observation: Guardian ant and jaggery store remain explicitly imagined.

art.caption: A winged ant, pictured without a prediction of its fate.
art.alt: A winged ant rests on the edge of a leaf.
art.observation: Winged ant image does not assert biological doom.

art.caption: An imagined contrast: a wide passage for the elephant, a twig across the ant’s path.
art.alt: An elephant walks through an open gateway while a foreground ant faces a twig.
art.observation: Elephant and twig contrast reads clearly; scale is illustrative.

art.caption: An ant climbing an unlit lampstand.
art.alt: A small ant climbs the broad base of a tall unlit metal lampstand.
art.observation: Unlit lampstand makes ascent visible without endorsing hierarchy.

art.caption: An imagined difference of scale: fallen leaves beside an elephant and ants.
art.alt: An elephant eats leaves while enlarged foreground ants stand near fallen foliage.
art.observation: Enlarged foreground ants and elephant meal are labelled imagined scale.

art.caption: An indirect illustration of unequal scale: ants on a rock above shallow water, an elephant beyond.
art.alt: Ants stand on a rock in shallow water while an elephant walks away in the distance.
art.observation: Indirect unequal-scale image is accurately captioned, not falsely literalized as urination.

art.caption: Keeping the sweet store covered.
art.alt: A hand lowers a domed cover over jaggery on a tray as ants approach along the shelf.
art.observation: Hand and cover geometry readable; covered store contrasts with guardian entry.

art.caption: Two imagined lines: people approaching a gathering and ants crossing the foreground.
art.alt: A curving line of people in everyday clothing walks toward a simple canopy while a separate line of ants echoes the curve.
art.observation: Distinct human and ant paths, ordinary clothing, no rank caricature.

art.caption: Drawn towards sweetness.
art.alt: Several ants approach and climb a small rough lump of jaggery.
art.observation: Jaggery attraction readable; interest is not reduced to greed.
